mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_SEQ as itemSeq, EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, QUESTION_SEQ as questionSeq, ITEM as item, ITEM_VALUE as itemValue, ITEM_IMG as itemImg, `ORDER` as `order`, JUMP_QUESTION as jumpQuestion, OTHER_YN as otherYn, OTHER_PLACEHOLDER as otherPlaceholder, REG_DATE as regDate, REG_ID as regId FROM SURVEY_ITEM WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} ORDER BY QUESTION_SEQ, `ORDER`

SELECT ITEM_SEQ as itemSeq, EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, QUESTION_SEQ as questionSeq, ITEM as item, ITEM_VALUE as itemValue, ITEM_IMG as itemImg, `ORDER` as `order`, JUMP_QUESTION as jumpQuestion, OTHER_YN as otherYn, OTHER_PLACEHOLDER as otherPlaceholder, REG_DATE as regDate, REG_ID as regId FROM SURVEY_ITEM WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND QUESTION_SEQ = #{questionSeq} ORDER BY `ORDER`
